example: She spoke about her anxiety with complete candor.
example_zh: 她完全坦白地說出她的憂慮。

example: The fox is a canine animal.
example_zh: 狐狸是犬科動物。

example: In that country, gunpowder was manufactured and used in both rocketry and cannon.
example_zh: 在那個國家，火藥被製造並用於火箭和大砲。

example: We went around canvassing and collected 500 dollars for the school.
example_zh: 我們到處遊說，為學校募得了五百美元。
memory_hint: canvass 可指四處遊說、拉票。

example: Her capricious behavior has annoyed her friends.
example_zh: 她善變的行為惹惱了她的朋友。

example: A sudden strong wind capsized their boat.
example_zh: 突然一陣強風弄翻了他們的船。

example: There is nothing in this plastic capsule which is transparent all the way around.
example_zh: 在那個透明的塑膠小盒裡什麼都沒有。

example: Deliverance from captivity made him a changed man.
example_zh: 從囚禁獲釋使他變成了一個人。
memory_hint: captivity 指被囚禁、受束縛的狀態。

example: Monosaccharides are the basic units of carbohydrates.
example_zh: 單醣是碳水化合物的基本單位。
chinese: 碳水化合物；醣；含醣食物

example: He suffered from a cardiac disease.
example_zh: 他患有心臟病。

example: The cardinal idea of the Constitution is that all people are born equal.
example_zh: 憲法的基本觀點是人生來都是平等的。
memory_hint: cardinal 作形容詞指最重要、基本的。

example: The young employee claims she was caressed by the manager and wants to sue him for harassment.
example_zh: 這個年輕職員聲稱她被經理撫摸並想要告他性騷擾。

example: They don't think this caretaker is trustworthy.
example_zh: 他們認為這個管理員不可靠。
memory_hint: caretaker 指照顧或管理的人。

example: He does very funny caricatures of famous people.
example_zh: 他畫著名人物的滑稽漫畫。
memory_hint: caricature 指誇張、諷刺性的漫畫或模仿。

example: The last time he saw her, she was in carnation.
example_zh: 他最後一次見到她的時候，她穿著深紅色的衣服。
memory_hint: carnation 可指康乃馨，也可指淡紅色。

example: Carnivorous animals have long sharp tearing teeth.
example_zh: 肉食動物有長而銳利的牙齒。

example: Why do you always carp at my errors even though I've done quite well?
example_zh: 你為什麼總是挑我的錯，甚至在我已經做得很好的時候？
memory_hint: carp at 表不斷挑剔、吹毛求疵。

example: The council of ministers said it backs Angola joining Opec Cartel.
example_zh: 部長會議表示支持安哥拉加入石油輸出國家組織卡特爾。
memory_hint: cartel 指企業或組織間的聯合。

example: The children drank up several big cartons of Coke after playing in the hot sun.
example_zh: 孩子們在烈日下玩耍後，把幾大盒的可樂喝個精光。
chinese: 紙盒；紙板箱；一紙盒的量

example: A cascade of noise came from the next door.
example_zh: 隔壁傳來一連串的噪音。
memory_hint: cascade 可比喻接連而來的一串事物。

example: The manager was cashiered for divulging vital information of the company.
example_zh: 經理因洩露公司的重要資訊而被開除。
memory_hint: cashier 作動詞指開除、撤職。

example: If you spend all your time gambling in the casino, I will divorce you.
example_zh: 如果你把全部時間都花在賭場裡賭博，我就和你離婚。

example: The man, whose family is Brahmins, has lost caste for marrying a maidservant.
example_zh: 那個來自婆羅門家庭的男人因為和女傭結婚而喪失了社會地位。
memory_hint: caste 指種姓、階級或社會地位。

example: The flood in 1997 was a terrible catastrophe.
example_zh: 1997年的大洪水是一場可怕的災難。

example: The film which catered to westerners' tastes was criticized by the public.
example_zh: 這部迎合西方人口味的電影受到大眾的批評。
chinese: 提供飲食；滿足需要；迎合
memory_hint: cater to 表迎合、滿足需要。

example: I would like you to do the catering for my daughter's wedding.
example_zh: 我想請你們承辦我女兒的結婚酒席。
chinese: 承辦酒席；提供飲食及服務

example: The dentist says I have 3 cavities that need filling.
example_zh: 牙醫說我有三個蛀洞需要填補。
memory_hint: cavity 可指空洞或蛀牙洞。

example: Celery is an excellent source of vitamin C which helps to support the immune system.
example_zh: 芹菜有豐富的維他命C，可以增強免疫力。

example: There is something wrong with the pipe in the cellar so we should ask a plumber to fix it.
example_zh: 地下室的水管有些問題，我們應該請水電工修理一下。

example: The cello, one of the major instruments in the string family, is the tenor voice in this family.
example_zh: 大提琴是弦樂家族的主要樂器之一，扮演著男高音的角色。

example: Water usually freezes at the temperature of 0 degrees Celsius.
example_zh: 水通常是在攝氏零度的時候結冰。

example: The census is a reliable source for describing the characteristics of a country's people.
example_zh: 統計數據是描繪一個國家民族特性的可靠資源。
memory_hint: census 指人口普查或其統計資料。

example: He is trying to find a manufacturer of hand-made ceramic plates that have special pictures on them.
example_zh: 他正試圖尋找會做有特殊圖案的手工陶瓷盤的廠商。

example: I can certify that she told you the truth.
example_zh: 我可以保證她告訴你的是實話。

example: A chapel built in the 15th century is often rich in unusual carvings.
example_zh: 建於15世紀的小教堂通常有很多不尋常的雕刻品。

example: One of the main causes for chapped skin is extended exposure to the wind, cold and sun.
example_zh: 長時間暴露在風吹、寒冷或烈日是皮膚裂開的主因之一。

example: High-quality charcoal made from fruit trees is much in demand.
example_zh: 用果樹製成的高品質木炭有很高的需求。

example: Chariot races, possibly the oldest spectacular sport in Rome, were held only on religious festivals.
example_zh: 戰車競賽也許是羅馬最古老的公開表演運動，只在宗教節日舉辦。

example: He chattered on and on about what happened recently.
example_zh: 他不停地談論著最近發生的事。

example: Chicken garnished with chili is very delicious.
example_zh: 上面加了辣椒的雞肉真的很好吃。

example: Chimpanzees, which are closely related to humans, often use tools in the wild.
example_zh: 黑猩猩和人類的關係密切，牠們在野外常使用工具。

example: Several students who chiseled for good grades were severely punished.
example_zh: 幾個為拿高分而作弊的學生受到嚴厲處罰。
memory_hint: chisel 除鑿刻外，也可指欺騙。

example: The choir sang so sweetly that the audience gave them a big hand.
example_zh: 唱詩班唱得很悅耳，觀眾給他們熱烈鼓掌。

example: There is an acute unemployment problem in this country though its economy is flourishing.
example_zh: 這個國家雖然經濟蓬勃發展，卻有嚴重的長期失業問題。
memory_hint: chronic 指長期持續、慢性的。

example: The earth's circumference is more than 40,000 kilometers.
example_zh: 地球的圓周超過四萬公里。

example: She shuts up like a clam as soon as you mention her past.
example_zh: 你一提到她的過去，她就守口如瓶。
memory_hint: clam 可比喻沉默寡言的人。

example: My whole clan comes to stay with her every Christmas.
example_zh: 每到耶誕節，她所有的家族都來和她一起住。

example: She put her hand out and clasped her daughter's hand.
example_zh: 她伸出手來緊握著女兒的手。

example: The field of clinical anatomy is very important for the exchange of information between anatomists and clinicians.
example_zh: 臨床解剖學對解剖學家和臨床醫師之間的資訊交流非常重要。

example: The clock does not work, the hands no longer turn clockwise.
example_zh: 這個鐘壞了，因為指針不再依順時針方向轉動。

example: Women who are pregnant should avoid ingesting red clover.
example_zh: 懷孕的女性應該避免吃紅花苜蓿。

example: This coalition is a non-profit organization which aims to end domestic violence.
example_zh: 該聯盟是一個非營利組織，旨在終結家庭暴力。
memory_hint: coalition 指組織或團體的聯盟。

example: According to this survey, about 33.7 million Americans had tried cocaine at least once in their lifetimes.
example_zh: 根據這項調查，大約有3370萬美國人一生中至少吸食過一次古柯鹼。

example: Belgium, once called the cockpit of Europe, has the highest quality of life in the world now.
example_zh: 曾被稱作歐洲戰場的比利時，現在是世界上生活品質最高的國家。
memory_hint: cockpit 可指駕駛艙，也可比喻戰場。

example: The naughty boy tore the cocoon open to see whether there was a pupa.
example_zh: 淘氣的男孩將繭撕開看看裡面有沒有蛹。

example: Pass me a coil of thread so I can run up the small tear in my dress.
example_zh: 拿給我一卷線，我要縫補衣服上的小裂口。
memory_hint: coil 指捲成圈狀的一卷。

example: The man who was in collaboration with the enemy was sentenced to death.
example_zh: 與敵人勾結的那個人被判處死刑了。
memory_hint: collaboration 可指合作，也可指與敵方勾結。

example: The two trains collided and 65 people died.
example_zh: 兩列火車相撞，導致65人死亡。

example: You will be in trouble if your political activities bring you into collision with the law.
example_zh: 如果你的政治活動使你觸犯法律，你就會有麻煩了。

example: The colonel was ill so he could not parade his troops today.
example_zh: 陸軍上校生病了，所以今天不能校閱部隊。

example: He used to be a humor columnist who writes funny stories and witty commentary.
example_zh: 他過去是個幽默專欄作家，撰寫有趣故事和機智評論。

example: Unlike the other small bodies in the solar system, the comet has been known since antiquity.
example_zh: 和其他太陽系裡的小天體不同，彗星在古時候就被人們知道了。

example: She commenced studying music in 1987 and ten years later became a famous musician.
example_zh: 她於1987年開始學音樂，十年後，她成為一名著名的音樂家。

example: This football commentator, who took sides with the Italian team, has apologized to the public.
example_zh: 那個偏袒義大利隊的足球評論員已向大眾道歉。

example: I don't like films that deal with commonplace themes.
example_zh: 我不喜歡主題平庸的電影。
chinese: 平淡無味的；平凡的；普通的

example: After much deliberation, the Commonwealth agreed to make a compact with that country.
example_zh: 再三考慮之後，聯邦同意和那個國家訂立契約。
memory_hint: commonwealth 可指共和國或聯邦。

example: Communal property is defined somewhat differently by different nations.
example_zh: 公共財產在不同的國家定義不同。

example: Her sentence was commuted from life imprisonment to 20 years' imprisonment for good behavior.
example_zh: 她因表現良好而獲減刑，由終生監禁改判為20年有期徒刑。

example: The building of commuter express rail routes is of essential significance to the 2008 Beijing Olympic Games.
example_zh: 專為通勤者建造的快車軌道對於2008年奧運會非常重要。
memory_hint: commuter 指每日往返通勤的人。

example: After several months' of negotiation, these countries made a compact to control drug trafficking.
example_zh: 經過幾個月的談判，這幾個國家達成控制毒品走私的協議。
memory_hint: compact 作名詞可指協議、契約。

example: The one you are looking for is in the first-class compartment.
example_zh: 你要找的那個人在頭等火車包廂。

example: That is a free software license which is compatible with the GNU (General Public License).
example_zh: 這是免費的軟體許可證，可以與 GNU（通用公共授權）相容。
chinese: 能共融的；適合的；相容的

example: Your arguments were not compelling enough to convince the jury of the defendant's innocence.
example_zh: 你的論點不能令陪審團相信被告是無辜的。
chinese: 強制的；令人信服的；令人注目的
memory_hint: compelling 指有說服力、引人注意。

example: They are facing a problem of great complexity.
example_zh: 他們正面臨著一個很複雜的問題。

example: Composite culture has been the mainstay of Indian society for ages.
example_zh: 很長一段時間以來，混合文化就是印度社會的支柱。
memory_hint: composite 指由多個部分合成的。

example: The cold compress can be used to regulate blood circulation.
example_zh: 冷敷袋可用於調節血液循環。
memory_hint: compress 作名詞指敷布、敷袋。

example: The rescue team, comprised of 8 doctors and 4 nurses, will arrive in 2 hours.
example_zh: 由8名醫生和4名護士組成的救援隊將於2個小時內到達。

example: The government decided to scrap charges for rural students during their nine-year compulsory education.
example_zh: 政府決定免除農村學生九年義務教育的費用。
chinese: 必須做的；義務的；強制的

example: Should students be taught how to use condoms?
example_zh: 應該教導學生如何使用保險套嗎？

example: The directorate is conferring with experts on the best way to develop new products.
example_zh: 董事會正在與專家商討開發新產品的最佳方法。

example: Would you please describe the configuration of that mountain?
example_zh: 你能描述那座山的輪廓嗎？
memory_hint: configuration 指結構、配置或輪廓。

example: He was absent at the congressional roll call due to illness.
example_zh: 大會點名時發現他因生病而缺席。
memory_hint: congressional 為 congress 的形容詞。

example: You cannot fire that janitor; he is very conscientious.
example_zh: 你不能開除那個管理員，他是個很認真的員工。
chinese: 憑良心的；認真的；勤勉熱衷的

example: The company has had record profits for 2 consecutive years.
example_zh: 該公司連續兩年的獲利都創下紀錄。

example: The two countries have reached a number of consensuses, although they still disagree on some issues.
example_zh: 儘管一些問題仍有分歧，這兩個國家已經在很多問題上達成共識。

example: I have the consolation of knowing that you have passed the exam.
example_zh: 得知你通過考試，我感到很欣慰。
chinese: 安慰；慰藉；安慰的人事物

example: With his new film he has consolidated his position as the world's leading director.
example_zh: 他的新電影鞏固了他身為國際傑出導演的地位。

example: A consortium of five manufacturers was entrusted with the direction of the project.
example_zh: 5家廠商所組成的聯合企業受託執行這個專案。
memory_hint: consortium 指聯合企業或財團。
